renderContract.commonPrompt: Premium Stella guardian story illustration, full-bleed 3:4 master art. Show exactly the guardians named in the approved card and preserve each approved character-sheet identity and signature prop; never add a third figure. Keep a clear emotional protagonist and a supportive companion, except that the canonical Gemini and Pisces pairs may share focus. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor on visible paper texture, rounded plush proportions, dark-purple outlines and eyes, exactly one large and one small eye highlight. Keep the guardians and relational beat at 55–65% of the frame and readable at 80px, with safe UI framing. Make support visible through distance, gaze, gesture, and one simple prop without solving, pushing, or choosing for the protagonist. Use symbols and shapes only: no readable text, title, badge, zodiac glyph, logo, or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Do not reuse any composition from the close-emotion or action-beat batches. Make every composition family, camera angle, pair silhouette, and support gesture visibly distinct within this batch.
